name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Account Management | Multi-Level Accounts, Negotiation & Program Expansion
summary: Account manager and negotiator with 15+ years in B2B sales and account management, at my best growing an existing book across every layer of a customer. At Birdeye, ran a two-step channel motion: signed 15-20 reseller partners, then drove adoption down to their end customers, retaining all but one (~94%). Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, negotiating terms with C-suite buyers. Spent 15+ years in restaurant kitchens before tech, and co-owned a Denver business with vendor and supplier relationships built from scratch, so the café operator's view of a delivery and a price sheet is familiar ground. Denver based, HubSpot fluent, and used to remote, high-autonomy work.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the full client relationship for a portfolio of small, owner-operated businesses, from negotiation and scoping through delivery, reporting, and renewal.
Expand accounts by identifying under-served needs and scoping complementary services, building repeatable programs each new client launches from.
Track account status, terms, and pipeline in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, reporting results to owners on a regular cadence.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, aligning internal departments on execution without direct authority, and ran QBRs on ROI and margin-relevant KPIs.
Advised clients on budget planning and allocation, and resolved feedback quickly to protect retention.

experience.title: Channel Account Manager (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Ran a two-step channel motion: signed and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), then drove activation down to each partner's end customers, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Stayed involved through activation instead of handing off, training partners and their teams and tracking utilization to catch stalled accounts early.
Worked with partners across health, home services, and retail, managing relationships at the owner, manager, and end-customer level.
Advised partners on retention and customer health metrics, and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (several over $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings, while leading the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio, including established retail businesses adding e-commerce, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led a team of 20 (later 8), and drove process improvements for a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, earning into accelerator tiers.
Negotiated terms and scoped multi-part implementation and services agreements with C-suite buyers, averaging ~$17,750/month in services bookings (~$213K annualized).

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold a loyalty and marketing platform to local SMB owners, including food and beverage operators.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Built vendor and supplier relationships and workflows from scratch for a licensed Denver retail business, alongside intake, compliance, and reporting, scaling it to profitability.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
